summary_en: 4,000,000 shares to be cancelled, representing 0.4% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Cancellation scheduled for 2026-07-31. Conditional on completion of ongoing public tender offer for treasury stock acquisition. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding expected to total 949,183,028.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: JX Advanced Metals Corporation announced on 2026-06-10 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 4,000,000 treasury shares pursuant to Company Law Article 178. The cancellation is scheduled for 2026-07-31 and is contingent upon successful completion of a public tender offer for treasury stock acquisition announced on 2026-05-11. The 4 million shares represent 0.4% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Treasury shares not cancelled will be retained for potential issuance upon conversion of euro-denominated convertible bonds. Post-cancellation, total issued shares outstanding are projected to total 949,183,028.
